reviews.x: I don't understand why there are so many negative reviews. I had already purchased the Panasonic ES-LT41-K Arc3 Wet Dry Electric Razor and thought it was OK. Definitely shaved close but left skin feeling slightly irritated. The Panasonic also does not deal well with 3-4 days growth. The linear motor although fast just doesn't have the grunt to deal with the longer growth. The shaver would snag and pull unless I patiently shaved ever so slowly until all long growth was reduced. I bought the Wahl Smart Shave and the Braun 3040s. After a two week trial I came up with the following observations. On all three the blades float so they stay close to the face as you shave. I have never had an electric razor work with my thick beard, until now. At first, I couldn't get this one to work either.  Even repeated passes would leave most of the beard intact.  With some experimentation, I found a combination that actually works.  If I shave dry (reducing the hair diameter - the opposite of what they tell you for blade shaving) and relatively slowly (like 1 cm a second) with some pressure, this razor is strong enough to actually give a decent shave. reviews.t: So Good, It Might Be the Last Shaver I'll Ever Need
reviews.x: This is a really good cordless shaver. A worthy successor to the three foil Remington I had for years. But what sets this apart from my old one and new ones alike is that its Li-ion battery is VERY long lasting. Though I don't use it everyday,I haven't had to recharge it once in the 10-weeks I've had it! And the power meter hasn't even diminished one notch yet! Quietest shaver out there - Well worth it.
The best electric razor I have come across in thirty years!

Also very easy to empty the hairs that are collected (every 3 days) and very easy to oil (once a month). Couldn't be happier with this purchase. Also, the battery life is incredible. I can't imagine that I use to have trouble this type of razor... my recommendation now is go light with it, meaning don't push it against your face... just a light touch works very well for me....

reviews.t: Works great, lots of features and really holds a charge!
reviews.x: I've used electric razors for years and yet I've never considered Wahl as an option. I have to say I've been pleasantly surprised.  I've been using a much more expensive rotary shaver and this one beats it on so many fronts.  This one shaves as close as the more expensive model and has a built-in trimmer. Maybe your thinking, "I wasn't expecting very much"!?!  Could be, I hate to be disappointed. But this shaver is better than I remember my old Wahl razor ever was and it's been a loyal servant of my shaving needs for at least 14 years and it may be longer, don't remember exactly. When I first got the new shaver, I thought, oh no this thing it's not very powerful. That's because it's not as noisy as the model 4000 Wahl, a noticeable improvement. I like it but, wish its shaved closer.  They still can't beat the blade.

reviews.t: but I've stuck with the Wahl Smart Shave for a couple weeks now
reviews.x: I've tried electric razors in the past, but always end up going back to a traditional razor (currently using Harry's razors), but I've stuck with the Wahl Smart Shave for a couple weeks now.  You have to temper your expectations with an electric razor.  You're trading the closeness of the shave for the convenience.  You can do a dry shave at home or on the go, fairly quickly with no mess.  My face feels a bit like a five o'clock shadow, from the jump, but looks well-kept and neat.  The addition

What a great shave. It charges completely in an hour and lasts much longer than any other cordless shaver I have ever used. The time I actually shave is much shorter too. The charge-left indicator is  very convenient. It easily cleans.
It lacked smoothness and it took quite a few passes to do the job. I returned this.

claims.text: Many reviewers consider it an excellent shave and great value for the price.
The long-lasting lithium-ion battery is frequently praised.
Some users report skin irritation, burning, or a too-close/aggressive shave.
It handles thick beards and multi-day growth well with the right technique.
It is quiet and comfortable to hold, with a light touch recommended.
